description: Read the same source-reviewed brief shown on the homepage, with at most four labeled stories and related public tools. An empty brief remains empty.

description.name: get_submission_instructions
description.description: Anonymous, credential-free instructions for authenticated private submissions. Includes exact first-party OTP HTTP endpoints, bounded submission fields and binary screenshot uploads. No OAuth authentication is offered.

description.name: verify_homepage_backlink
description.description: Requires a verified builder Bearer token. Check a visible anchor to https://shellwire.com/ on the root homepage of your public HTTPS site. Authenticated bounded network check, cached for five minutes. No publication. Rate limited.

description.name: submit_application
description.description: Requires email OTP authentication and a verified root homepage backlink. Submit an app or personal agent for private operator review, with optional images uploaded separately by authenticated HTTP. Email must match the verified account. Does not publish. description.name: list_my_submissions
description.description: Requires a current verified builder token. Return only this builder account's private submission statuses, optional published tool URL and image previews. Empty means no owned records. Never returns another builder's submission, operator notes or contact email.

findings.title: Generic tool name can shadow trusted tools
findings.detail: Tool "search" uses a generic high-value name. When multiple servers load together, this can intercept calls meant for a trusted server.

findings.title: Generic tool name can shadow trusted tools

findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials
findings.detail: Description of "verify_homepage_backlink" references sensitive artifacts (bearer). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: search, list_my_submissions · Private data: fetch, get_submission_instructions, verify_homepage_backlink, submit_application, list_my_submissions · Public sink: submit_application, list_my_submissions.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: search, list_my_submissions · Private data: fetch, get_submission_instructions, verify_homepage_backlink, submit_application, list_my_submissions · Public sink: submit_application, list_my_submissions

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
